items.title: 为破解净值困局，部分“消费”基金转投科技
items.raw_excerpt: 近段时间以来，面对科技主线的持续强势与传统消费的低位震荡，不少以“消费”为标签的主题基金为破解净值困局，开始跨界重仓硬科技赛道。多只消费主题基金凭借“万物皆消费”的理念重仓人工智能（AI）板块，在业绩方面实现了领跑。不过，有基金经理坦言，科技板块的“虹吸效应”极大挤压了消费板块的流动性，对于部分追求净值排名的基金经理而言，博弈科技被视为一种无奈之举。虽然拥抱AI与半导体的调仓动作换来了短期的业绩修复，却也让自己站上了“风格漂移”争议的风口浪尖。（证券时报）

title_i18n.zh: 为破解净值困局，部分“消费”基金转投科技
title_i18n.en: To break the net value deadlock, some "consumer" funds have shifted to technology investments.
title_i18n.es: Para resolver el dilema del valor neto, algunos fondos de "consumo" se han desviado hacia la tecnología.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 近段时间以来，面对科技主线的持续强势与传统消费的低位震荡，不少以“消费”为标签的主题基金为破解净值困局，开始跨界重仓硬科技赛道。多只消费主题基金凭借“万物皆消费”的理念重仓人工智能（AI）板块，在业绩方面实现了领跑。不过，有基金经理坦言，科技板块的“虹吸效应”极大挤压了消费板块的流动性，对于部分追求净值排名的基金经理而言，博弈科技被视为一种无奈之举。虽然拥抱AI与半导体的调仓动作换来了短期的业绩修复，却也让自己站上了“风格漂移”争议的风口浪尖。（证券时报）
excerpt_i18n.en: Recently, as the tech sector continues to strengthen while traditional consumer stocks remain in a low-level consolidation, many theme funds labeled as "consumer" have begun to cross over and heavily invest in the hard-tech track to break free from net value difficulties. Several consumer-themed funds, leveraging the concept of "everything is consumption," have heavily invested in the AI sector, achieving leading performance. However, some fund managers admit that the "siphoning effect" of the tech sector has significantly squeezed liquidity in the consumer sector. For some fund managers focused on net value rankings, betting on tech is seen as a last resort. While the shift toward AI and semiconductors has brought short-term performance recovery, it has also placed them at the center of controversy over "style drift." (Securities Times)
excerpt_i18n.es: Últimamente, ante la persistente fortaleza de la línea principal tecnológica y la volatilidad a la baja del consumo tradicional, muchos fondos temáticos etiquetados como "consumo" han comenzado a realizar apuestas transfronterizas en el sector de tecnología dura para resolver el estancamiento del valor neto. Varios fondos temáticos de consumo, basándose en la filosofía de "todo es consumo", han apostado fuertemente por el sector de inteligencia artificial (IA), logrando un rendimiento líder. Sin embargo, algunos gestores de fondos admiten que el "efecto de succión" del sector tecnológico ha reducido significativamente la liquidez del sector de consumo. Para aquellos gestores que buscan mejorar el ranking del valor neto, apostar por la tecnología se considera una medida forzada. Aunque el ajuste de cartera hacia la IA y los semiconductores ha logrado una recuperación temporal del rendimiento, también los ha colocado en medio de la controversia sobre el "desvío de estilo".

items.title: Why aren't more people worried about AI impersonation in code reviews?
items.raw_excerpt: This is something that has bothered me for quite a while, and I don't see a lot of people talk about it: Agents, in most cases, impersonate the human operator, by design, with no way to enforce, disclose, or control it. I believe this is causing an illusion of human in the loop, and is not intentional, and should be discussed. For example: All commits, pushes, PRs, and PR comments are all going to appear as the developer whether they wrote them or not. (You may have Co-authored-by, but not everyone has it set up). The good: you are accountable for what your AI wrote. The bad: while everyone should assume you used AI these days, there is still an expectation of some human-in-the-loop. title_i18n.zh: 为什么没有更多人担心代码审查中的人工智能冒充问题？
title_i18n.es: ¿Por qué no hay más gente preocupada por la suplantación de identidad mediante IA en las revisiones de código?

The good: you are accountable for what your AI wrote. The bad: while everyone should assume you used AI these days, there is still an expectation of some human-in-the-loop. When your agent uses the GitHub MCP or CLI, it's most likely using an OAuth authorization (even if it's a G
excerpt_i18n.zh: 有件事困扰我很久了，而且没见多少人讨论：大多数情况下，智能体在设计上会冒充人类操作员，且无法强制、披露或控制这种行为。
excerpt_i18n.es: Esto es algo que me ha molestado durante bastante tiempo, y no veo que mucha gente hable de ello: los agentes, en la mayoría de los casos, se hacen pasar por el operador humano por diseño, sin forma de imponer, revelar o controlarlo.

title_i18n.es: La IA es un separador.

excerpt_i18n.en: Today I learned about technologies being separators. I watched a fantastic video that only has a few views and subscribers. I think it will explode soon: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1CbmC2aWhjY . As of now Sunday 17th of may, 3.5K Views only 205 subscribers (refreshed the page and it has already 600 subscribers in an hour or so).
excerpt_i18n.zh: 今天我了解到技术正在成为分隔物。我看了一个非常棒的视频，虽然观看量和订阅者还很少，但我觉得它很快就会火起来：https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1CbmC2aWhjY 。截至周日17日
excerpt_i18n.es: Hoy aprendí sobre las tecnologías como separadores. Vi un vídeo fantástico que tiene pocas visualizaciones y suscriptores. Creo que explotará pronto: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1CbmC2aWhjY . A día de hoy, domingo 17.

items.title: Vercel's Zero: A Programming Language Designed for AI Agents
items.raw_excerpt: Every serious coding agent including Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, whatever you're using shares the same quiet problem. The agent writes code, the compiler throws an error, and the agent has to read text written for a human engineer to figure out what went wrong and how to fix it. That sounds like a minor inconvenience. In practice it's one of the main reasons agentic coding loops break down. Error message formats change between compiler versions. The same underlying problem

items.title: Revamped Siri will reportedly offer auto-deleting chats
items.raw_excerpt: Apple is hoping that its record on privacy can be the differentiator on the AI front, and maybe even buy it a little slack as it continues to lag behind the competition. According to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman, the more chatbot-like Siri set to debut in iOS 27 will include the option to autodelete chat histories. […]

items.title: University of Arizona students boo Eric Schmidt’s AI cheerleading during commencement
items.raw_excerpt: Former Google CEO Eric Schmidt delivered the commencement address at the University of Arizona on Friday. And, as his speech veered into talk of AI, he was repeatedly drowned out by boos. AI is already a contentious topic, and it's not surprising that those about to enter a ravaged job market feel particularly negative about […]

title_i18n.en: University of Arizona students boo Eric Schmidt’s AI cheerleading during commencement
title_i18n.zh: 亚利桑那大学学生在毕业典礼上对埃里克·施密特的人工智能鼓吹发出嘘声。
title_i18n.es: Estudiantes de la Universidad de Arizona abuchean el discurso de Eric Schmidt a favor de la IA durante la ceremonia de graduación.

excerpt_i18n.en: Former Google CEO Eric Schmidt delivered the commencement address at the University of Arizona on Friday. And, as his speech veered into talk of AI, he was repeatedly drowned out by boos. AI is already a contentious topic, and it's not surprising that those about to enter a ravaged job market feel particularly negative about […]
excerpt_i18n.zh: 前谷歌CEO埃里克·施密特周五在亚利桑那大学发表毕业典礼演讲。当他的演讲转向人工智能话题时，多次被嘘声淹没。人工智能本就是一个有争议的话题。
excerpt_i18n.es: El exdirector ejecutivo de Google, Eric Schmidt, pronunció el discurso de graduación en la Universidad de Arizona el viernes. Y, cuando su discurso derivó hacia el tema de la inteligencia artificial, fue repetidamente acallado por abucheos. La IA ya es un tema polémico.
